record.field: Confirm a supplier bank-detail change + prepare, register or release payments

Billing, Accountant and Accounting Administrator (the payment releaser, A08 F1) all hold Invoicing: they raise bills, payment runs and payments and release them. The call-back that vouches for a supplier's new bank account is independent only if the confirmer is outside the payables and treasury chain; together the two duties redirect a payment to an account the same person vouched for (A08 D1/S4, M52-1, M50-1; BRU-APE-09).
Propose + confirm a supplier bank-detail change

The steward proposes a bank-detail change and the approver confirms it after the call-back; one person holding both can propose and confirm their own redirection on any supplier (A06 S1/S7, A08 S4). The per-record proposer != confirmer check stays in cd_vendor_portal.
